question: What Are the Types of Alarms in DCS?
body_html:
Types of alarms in DCS are grouped by what they protect, how urgent they are and what action is needed. A DCS alarm is raised when a process variable or system condition crosses a set limit.

Alarm typeWhat it warns about
ProcessPV out of normal range, e.g. low drum level
EquipmentMachine stress or malfunction
SafetyHazards to people and plant
QualityProduct out of specification
MaintenanceService or calibration due
CommunicationLoss of signal or network link
